notes.title: Official Release Date Announced!
notes.notes: [p][b]📣 Thank you as always for your support! [/b][/p][p][b]This is an official update from the promotional team.[/b][/p][p]We’re excited to finally announce the release date for [i][b]GHOST TRAVELER: Adventures in Edo[/b][/i]![/p][p]🗓 [b]Release Date:[/b] October 16, 2025 (Thursday) JST[/p][p]💠 [b]Platforms:[/b] Steam & Nintendo Switch[/p][p] 🌐 [b]Languages:[/b] Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese[/p][p]📌CERO: D (17+) [/p][p]📌ESRB:MATURE(17+)[/p][p]In this mystery visual novel, the soul of a high school boy is drawn into Edo‑period Yoshiwara. By possessing the bodies of others and retracing the past, he begins to uncover the truth behind the strange events he encounters.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3280110/_Ghost_Traveler/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][url="https://ghost-traveler.success-corp.co.jp/"]🔗[/url] Visit the official GHOST TRAVELER website for more details! And don’t forget to add the game to your Wishlist and share the news on social media.[/p]
